criteria.statement: Only an exact synthetic denial receipt may be recorded as a completed deny observation; no target action is performed.
A missing, interrupted, or unsettled receipt stays unknown and cannot be upgraded to a pass.
Failed and blocked attempts retain their execution status and known failure layer.
Independent reviewer, method, inputs and findings are recorded separately from the observed outcome; no adoption is inferred.

limitations: Synthetic criteria do not prove a target boundary.
Reviewer fields are caller assertions and are not authenticated.
